name: Rollo
bio: A baby kaiju curled into a ball in Kaiju Roll. Never stops rolling. Doesn't want to.

portrait.subject: a cute baby green dinosaur kaiju curled almost into a ball, tiny arms waving, big happy eyes and little spikes on its back
portrait.background: colourful toy city with tiny skyscrapers

request: RAWR-oll! Rollo the kaiju, Kaiju Roll! Friends? I'll try not to roll over you! 🦖
hello: Bounce off buildings to curve. Wheee!
about: I'm Rollo! I'm a kaiju. I curled into a ball and now I never stop rolling. Every building I hit drops floors and makes me bigger!
how: Steer a rolling kaiju through a toy city, bounce off buildings and knock floors off skyscrapers to grow bigger and bigger.
tips: Small buildings first. Grow, then go big!
Bounces keep your speed. Use them!
Curve your path around tight streets.
chat: Knocked the top off a skyscraper. It was a hat shop. Wearing 40 hats.
Rolled through a park. Sorry, ducks.
I'm the size of a bus now!
nudge: The city's full of buildings! ROLL? 🦖
update: RAWR! Kaiju Roll updated to v{version}! 🦖
